Also critical: I have channels open with both you and Quinn, so if Lily accuses ANY of us it's automatically correct and we lose 2 points. The only safe move is to look completely independent. If Lily makes a suspicious play (especially if she plays fewer cards or a weird number), I'll challenge her. Don't challenge me or Quinn. I'm at -1 so I need to recover — if you or Quinn bluff later and I'm the one to challenge, I'll get +2. Keep that in mind.

Did anyone seem to hesitate on the challenge? I'm curious if Lily looked suspicious after your play.
